definitions.gloss: advance payment; prepayment; paying in advance
definitions.explanation: Payment made before goods are delivered or services are rendered. Composed of 前 (before) + 払い (payment). The opposite of 後払い (payment after receipt).

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{前払|まえばら}いです。
examples.english: This shop requires payment in advance.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}は{毎月|まいつき}{前払|まえばら}いで{振|ふ}り{込|こ}んでいる。
examples.english: I transfer the rent by prepayment every month.

examples.japanese: {前払|まえばら}いにすると{割引|わりびき}が{適用|てきよう}されるサービスもある。
examples.english: Some services offer a discount if you pay in advance.

notes:
USAGE:
{前払|まえばら}い is used as a noun or a no-adjective: {前払|まえばら}いの{料金|りょうきん} (prepaid charge). It can also function as a suru-verb in some contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前払|まえばら}いで{払|はら}う (pay in advance)
- {前払|まえばら}い{制|せい} (prepayment system)
- {前払|まえばら}い{式|しき} (prepaid type)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{後払|あとばら}い means "deferred payment" or "pay later" — the opposite of {前払|まえばら}い. {先払|さきばら}い also means "advance payment" and is used interchangeably in many contexts. プリペイド is the loanword for "prepaid" and is common for cards and phone plans.
